attributes=None, *, msg=None, all_or_any=all):", "        \"\"\"Perform is_fitted validation for estimator.", "    ", "        Checks if the estimator is fitted by verifying the presence of", "        fitted attributes (ending with a trailing underscore) and otherwise", "        raises a :class:`~sklearn.exceptions.NotFittedError` with the given message.", "    ", "        If an estimator does not set any attributes with a trailing underscore, it", "        can define a ``__sklearn_is_fitted__`` method returning a boolean to", "        specify if the estimator is fitted or not. See", "        :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_developing_estimators_sklearn_is_fitted.py`", "        for an example on how to use the API.", "    ", "        If no `attributes` are passed, this function will pass if an estimator is stateless.", "        An estimator can indicate it's stateless by setting the `requires_fit` tag.
